title: Story arcs list: adapt Go arcs contract so /story/arcs renders instead of crashing

spec.problem: Production /vi/story/arcs shows the error boundary: TypeError reading 'ring' because the Go /api/story/arcs returns status 'published' and omits progress/synopsis/accent fields the page assumes

acceptance.text: storyArcs() adapts the Go list contract: status 'published' maps to 'active', missing totalChapters/completedChapters default to 0, missing npcSlugs/chapterIds to [], synopsis to empty, bossChapterId to null; slug, titles, rankCodeEntry and displayOrder are preserved
MissionArcCard renders for a published arc and for an unrecognized status without throwing; it omits the 'completed / total' progress row and empty synopsis when totalChapters is 0
Detail/chapter contracts and all existing career-rpg tests are unchanged and pass

spec.expected_behavior: The arcs list renders every published arc; unknown statuses never crash; progress and synopsis are shown only when the backend supplies them (no fabricated counts)
spec.observed_behavior: GET /api/story/arcs returns [{id,slug,titleJa,titleVi,rankCodeEntry,status:'published',displayOrder}]; MissionArcCard does STATUS_TONE[arc.status].ring on undefined and the page crashes
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the commit; the list page returns to the error boundary but no data is affected

red_targets.test: storyArcs API adapter > adapts the Go arcs list (status published, no progress fields) to a renderable MissionArc
MissionArcCard > does not crash on a status the UI does not know
MissionArcCard > renders a backend arc without progress counts and does not invent a 0 / 0 progress row
